author: Diana May
text: Ralph was an absolute pleasure to deal with from start to finish. He worked on our B100 and was incredibly responsive, trustworthy, and knowledgeable throughout the entire process. It’s hard to find someone who is both reliable and easy to work with, and Ralph exceeded our expectations. We truly appreciated his professionalism and honesty, and we would definitely recommend him to our family and friends without hesitation.

author: Jon Mace
text: RPM had a better price and INFINITELY better service than my previous septic company.  They told me when they were coming and then texted me 25 minutes ahead.  In an era when we can track grocery deliveries I don’t understand the companies that can only tell you “Tuesday between 12 and 5”.  RPM IS NOT THAT. They are better. Good people good service.

author: Morgan Fisher
text: Absolute 10/10 service. Small, family owned company.  So knowledgeable and fast.  Jamie and his crew came for a (long overdue) service- they pumped the tank, cleaned up- I had no idea they were even there.  Amazing work and I’m so thankful!

author: Young Koh
text: We had an issue with our septic system overflowing, so I reached out to RPM Septic Systems. They actually called me back first and reminded me they had pumped the tank just six months ago, so it was unlikely to be full again so soon. They suggested they would come and check the filter first, which made a lot of sense. That’s exactly what they did—and once they replaced the damaged filter, the water level went right back down. Not only did that save me the cost of an unnecessary pumping, but it also gave me real peace of mind knowing I can trust them. Really appreciate the help—thank you!

author: Jim Vento
text: Ralph and Chuck were very knowledgeable and professional.   Even though my property needed to be excavated I was surprised how clean and neat the yard was left.  Best of all, no more water issues!
